name: Industrials Momentum Long/Short
description: Cross-sectional momentum long/short strategy on US Industrials stocks. Long leg: top 3 stocks breaking above the 60-day Donchian upper band, ranked by 60-day momentum. Short leg: bottom 3 stocks breaking below the 60-day Donchian lower band, ranked by 60-day momentum. Equal-weight allocation per leg (33.3% each position), weekly rebalance. Exits when a stock is no longer in the top/bottom 3 at rebalance.
source:
# Industrials Momentum Breakout — Cross-Sectional Rotational Strategy
# =============================================================================
# Momentum breakout strategy on US Industrials stocks using 60-day Donchian
# Channels for breakout detection and cross-sectional ranking for selection.
#
# Universe: XLI, CAT, DE, GE, HON, MMM, UNP, RTX
#
# RULES:
# - Long Breakout: Close > Prior bar's 60-day Donchian Upper Band
# - Short Breakdown: Close < Prior bar's 60-day Donchian Lower Band
# - Ranking: 60-day Rate of Change (momentum) across all assets
# - Long Selection: Top 3 breakout candidates by momentum each week
# - Short Selection: Bottom 3 breakdown candidates by momentum each week
# - Weighting: Equal weight per leg (1/3 ≈ 33.3% each position)
# - Rebalance: Weekly (first trading day of each week)
# - Exit Long: When a stock is no longer in the top 3 at weekly rebalance
# - Exit Short: When a stock is no longer in the bottom 3 at weekly rebalance
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 60-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 60 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=60)(src.h, src.l)
upper_band = donchian.bbands_upper

# Extract lower band for breakdown detection
lower_band = donchian.bbands_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 60-Day Rate of Change for momentum ranking
momentum_60d = roc(period=60)(close)

# =============================================================================
# BREAKOUT DETECTION & CROSS-SECTIONAL SELECTION
# =============================================================================

# LONG LEG — Breakout: Close above prior bar's 60-day Donchian upper band
breakout = close > upper_band_prior

# Mask momentum to only breakout stocks (non-breakout → null, excluded from ranking)
rank_signal_long = where(breakout, momentum_60d)

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 breakout candidates by momentum
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(rank_signal_long)

# SHORT LEG — Breakdown: Close below prior bar's 60-day Donchian lower band
breakdown = close < lower_band_prior

# Mask momentum to only breakdown stocks (non-breakdown → null, excluded from ranking)
rank_signal_short = where(breakdown, momentum_60d)

# Cross-sectional selection: bottom 3 breakdown candidates by momentum
is_bottom_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.bottom, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(rank_signal_short)

# =============================================================================
# WEEKLY REBALANCE SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Detect first trading day of each week
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# LONG: Enter when stock is in top 3 breakout at week start, exit when it leaves
enter_long = is_new_week and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_week and not is_top_3

# Hold long position from weekly entry until next weekly exit
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# SHORT: Enter when stock is in bottom 3 breakdown at week start, exit when it leaves
enter_short = is_new_week and is_bottom_3
exit_short = is_new_week and not is_bottom_3

# Hold short position from weekly entry until next weekly exit
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short, exit=exit_short)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long/short zone — longs from top 3 breakouts, shorts from bottom 3 breakdowns
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Equal weight per leg (1/3 each position within its leg)
long_weights = equal_weight()(held_long)
short_weights = equal_weight()(held_short)
combined_weights = coalesce(long_weights, short_weights, 0)

# Position sizing — equal weight per leg, rebalance only on weekly boundary
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=combined_weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
